description: This file contains buffer management functions for audio processing, including input/output handling, buffer copying, and state management for both managed and unmanaged buffer modes in an audio processing system.

methods.name: LVM_BufferIn
methods.description: Manages input buffer data, delegating to managed or unmanaged modes, handling sample copying and buffer state updates.

methods.name: LVM_BufferOut
methods.description: Manages output buffer data, delegating to managed or unmanaged modes, handling sample copying and buffer state updates.

methods.name: LVM_BufferManagedIn
methods.description: Handles buffer management for input in managed mode, including copying from delay buffers and input data, and managing buffer states.

methods.name: LVM_BufferUnmanagedIn
methods.description: Handles buffer management for input in unmanaged mode, setting process pointers and sample counts.

methods.name: LVM_BufferManagedOut
methods.description: Handles buffer management for output in managed mode, including copying delayed and processed samples to output buffers.

methods.name: LVM_BufferUnmanagedOut
methods.description: Handles buffer management for output in unmanaged mode, updating process pointers and sample counts.

methods.name: LVM_BufferOptimisedIn
methods.description: Optimized input buffer management for out-of-place processing, copying samples directly into output buffers when possible.

methods.name: LVM_BufferOptimisedOut
methods.description: Optimized output buffer management, copying remaining samples to delay buffers at the end of processing.
